turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
en applicable.
- Items purchased with warranty store credit will not come with a warranty of their own.
- Warranty replacements cannot be returned for a refund.
- If they meet the standard return criteria, warranty replacements can be exchanged for a different item or for warranty store credit only.
So if the replacement is also damaged, I can’t confirm any second warranty replacement from the policy I found. The policy only explicitly mentions a one-time replacement.
